word-damn.def: a mild swear word you say when you are annoyed or disappointed

word-crap.def: a mild swear word for something bad or untrue, or to show you are annoyed

word-shit-excl.def: a strong rude word you shout when you are angry or things go wrong

word-fuck-excl.def: a very strong rude word you shout when you are angry or frustrated

word-holy-shit.def: a strong rude exclamation you say when you are very surprised

phrase-go-to-hell.def: a rude thing you say to make someone leave you alone

phrase-fuck-off.def: an extremely rude order telling someone to leave immediately

phrase-shut-up.def: a rude order telling someone to stop talking

word-idiot.def: a person who does something very stupid

word-moron.def: a person you think is extremely stupid

word-jerk.def: a mean or unpleasant person who treats others badly

word-bastard.def: a rude word for a man you strongly dislike

word-asshole.def: a very rude word for a person who is cruel or annoying

word-bitch-insult.def: a strong insult for a woman who is unkind or unpleasant

word-son-of-a-bitch.def: an extremely rude insult for someone you hate or are angry with

word-motherfucker.def: an extremely offensive word for a person you hate

word-ass.def: a rude word for the part of the body you sit on

word-dick.def: a rude word for a man's sex organ

word-shit-n.def: a rude word for solid waste that leaves the body

word-piss.def: to pass liquid waste from the body, in a rude way

word-fart.def: to let air escape from your bottom, often with a noise

word-bloody-intensifier.def: a mild swear word used to make a statement stronger

word-fucking-intensifier.def: a very rude word used to make a statement much stronger

word-shitty.def: very bad or of poor quality, said in a rude way

word-pissed-off.def: very angry, said in a rude way

word-fuck-up.def: to ruin something completely by making a bad mistake, said in a rude way

word-bullshit.def: a rude word for lies or nonsense

word-swear.def: to use rude or offensive words, usually when you are angry

word-swear-word.def: a rude or offensive word that people say when they are angry
